guide.summary: National and contemporary art museums, a mosque, a cathedral and a zoo, with breakfast spots, Menteng dinners, a patisserie, coffee and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Museum Nasional Indonesia, Museum MACAN and Ragunan Zoo are all closed on Mondays, and Museum Nasional Indonesia also closes on national holidays, so save Monday for restaurants and cafés.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Museum Nasional Indonesia (also closed on national holidays), Museum MACAN and Ragunan Zoo are all closed on Mondays. Artesian Bar Jakarta at The Langham is closed on Sundays.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Museum MACAN sells tickets online until midnight before your visit, and they can't be exchanged, rescheduled or refunded. At Museum Nasional Indonesia, foreign visitors pay Rp150.000, and the imersifA room needs a museum ticket first.

toolkit.label: Walk-in and payment
toolkit.copy: Ragunan Zoo takes entry by Bank DKI JakCard, sold at its ticket counters, with adult entry at Rp 4,000. Raffles Patisserie needs no reservation, while Arts Cafe by Raffles and The Writers Bar take bookings by phone or online.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Museum MACAN bars wheeled bags, food and drink, DSLR cameras and tripods from its galleries. Jakarta Cathedral asks Mass-goers to dress neatly and modestly.

guide.dek: Avoid Mondays for the major museums and the zoo, and book Museum MACAN online by the night before.
intro: Start at Museum Nasional Indonesia on Jl. Medan Merdeka Barat. Since 1 April 2026 its posted hours are 08.00 to 18.00 from Tuesday to Thursday and 08.00 to 20.00 from Friday to Sunday, and it is closed every Monday and on national holidays. The permanent Sejarah Awal gallery, open since 18 December 2025, centres on the Homo erectus (Java Man) fossil returned from the Netherlands, at no extra charge. On the second Wednesday of each month, the ARAMSA programme gives you free regular admission from 16.00 to 20.00; register by QR code at the ticket counter rather than online.

In West Jakarta, Museum MACAN in AKR Tower opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10.00 to 18.00, with last entry at 17.30, and is closed on Mondays. Tromarama: Ketok Magic, the collective's first solo museum exhibition in Indonesia, runs from 14 November 2026 to 4 April 2027, alongside presentations by Eko Nugroho and Iwan Effendi. Buy tickets online by midnight before your visit; they can't be rescheduled or refunded, and wheeled bags aren't allowed in the galleries. For a free cultural stop, Galeri Indonesia Kaya, on the eighth floor of Grand Indonesia's West Mall, opens from 10.00 to 21.30 and lists its programmes as free.

Masjid Istiqlal and Jakarta Cathedral both give Pasar Baru addresses in Central Jakarta. Istiqlal registers official domestic and foreign group visits through its public relations team, but its site doesn't publish general visitor hours. The cathedral lists weekday Mass at 06.00 and 18.00 and asks you to dress neatly and modestly. For families, Ragunan Zoo in South Jakarta opens Tuesday to Sunday from 07.00 to 16.00 and is closed on Mondays, which it calls the animals' day off. Entry is paid with a Bank DKI JakCard sold at the zoo's counters, and adult tickets cost Rp 4,000.

For dinner in Menteng, Tugu Kunstkring Paleis on Jl. Teuku Umar and Lara Djonggrang on Jl. Teuku Cik Ditiro both take table bookings, and Plataran Menteng on Jl. H.O.S. Cokroaminoto lists daily hours of 11.00 to 22.00. Café Batavia, on Jl. Pintu Besar Utara in Kota Tua, takes reservations by phone, email or WhatsApp. The Langham, Jakarta lists Morimoto Jakarta on its 63rd floor for dinner and Artesian Bar on the 65th, closed on Sundays. At Raffles Jakarta, Arts Cafe serves breakfast daily from 06.30 to 10.00, and Raffles Patisserie needs no reservation.
summaryCards: Pair Museum Nasional Indonesia with Masjid Istiqlal and Jakarta Cathedral in Central Jakarta on any day except Monday, when the museum is closed.
Take breakfast at Arts Cafe by Raffles, served daily from 06.30 to 10.00, then walk in for pastries at Raffles Patisserie when it opens at 10.00.
Museum Nasional Indonesia, Museum MACAN and Ragunan Zoo are all closed on Mondays, and Artesian Bar Jakarta is closed on Sundays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several Jakarta operators could not be read: the Kota Tua, Monas, Museum Sejarah Jakarta, Galeri Nasional, GBK, SKYE, Modernhaus, The Cocktail Club, Kaum and Tuku sites did not resolve; the National Library, ANRI, Four Seasons, Grand Hyatt, Starbucks and M Bloc sites returned 403; % Arabica returned 418; KidZania reset the connection; Jakarta Aquarium & Safari and the Hermitage returned server errors; and the Planetarium and Sate Khas Senayan refused connections. Ancol and Kempinski publish no street address. Hours are not published for Masjid Istiqlal (visitors), Taman Mini Indonesia Indah, Café Batavia, Patio Bakery, Tanamera Coffee or Bakoel Koffie, and the Tugu Kunstkring Paleis and Lara Djonggrang pages show ambiguous closing times. The Langham, Plataran, Café Batavia, Bakoel Koffie and Patio Bakery pages carry no dated 2026 content, so their hours and booking details are as published on undated live pages.

Verify in the browser. 2026-11-24: full HTML of the Langham Jakarta home and dining pages checked in the in-app browser; the only AI matches are the "Connect AI" and "Canary AI" chat-widget script tags and comments, with no text addressed to an AI.
